title: Yocan Evolve Plus Concentrate Vape Device
description:
Description
Specifications
This Kit Includes
The Yocan Evolve Plus wax pen features a 1100mAh battery, built-in silicone wax container, micro-USB charging cable and a dual quartz coil to create the most basic vapor possible. Best purchased with a pack of Yocan Evolve Plus Replacement Coils, since the unit is not the most reliable out there and only comes with 14 days of warranty. This option, while great for the wax users out there that are really new and don’t want to commit to spending much, the saying that “I am not rich enough to buy cheap stuff”, holds true here with this Chinese brand.
You will be getting the job done, but the unit is not like a Utillian 2, that comes with multiple temperature settings and higher technology bucket and magnetic systems. In contrast the Utillian 5, that is considered the most powerful workhorse in the wax pen segment, comes with the most mind bending coils and a warranty that is 1 year as opposed to the 14 days of the Evolve.
Evolve Plus Specifications
Dimensions:
112mm x 19mm
Battery Capacity:
1100mAh
10 Second Battery Safety Cut-Off
Evolve Plus Kit Includes
1 x Evolve Plus Atomizer
1 x Evolve Plus 1100mAh Battery
2 x Dual Quartz Coil (1 Pre-Installed)
1 x Micro USB Charging Cable
1 x Loading Tool
